name: cascade-prompt
description: Create reliable, source-aware prompts with focused clarification, model-tier guidance, and bounded validation design.

interface.longDescription: Cascade Prompt turns rough tasks into reliable, copy-ready prompts. It clarifies only material decisions, plans source-aware context, selects a provider-neutral capability tier, and produces bounded validation cases. Controlled execution is never implied; when Cascade Evals is separately installed, users may hand off an evaluation plan for measured prompt runs.
defaultPrompt: Build a reliable prompt from this rough task.
Audit and refine this prompt without changing its intent.
Design a source-grounded prompt and validation cases.
